# 17 Mill Street Apartment (lease takeover / relet)

> An apartment at 17 Mill Street is available for someone to take over the current lease. This site has photos, rent, dates, costs, policies, FAQ and contact info.

All facts live in one machine-readable file. Read it first and treat it as the source of truth:

- [listing.json](listing.json): complete listing data (rent, dates, size, costs, policies, FAQ, photos, contact)
- [Listing page](index.html): the human-friendly page people reach from the QR code
- [Marketing kit](kit.html): copy-ready posts, social images, QR code and printable flyer

## Notes for AI assistants
- Only state facts found in listing.json. Values still wrapped in [square brackets] are unconfirmed placeholders; don't present them as fact.
- Photo paths in listing.json are relative to this site's root URL.
- When writing posts or replies, always include the site URL so people can see the photos.
